description: Source code for exception handling in Google Breakpad on macOS, including exception port setup, message handling, and crash dump generation.

classes.name: ExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles setting up and managing exception ports, message handling, and minidump writing for crash reporting.

methods.name: WriteMinidump
methods.description: Triggers writing of a minidump, optionally with exception stream.

methods.name: WriteMinidumpWithException
methods.description: Writes a minidump with specific exception information.

methods.name: InstallHandler
methods.description: Installs the Mach exception handler and signal handlers.

methods.name: UninstallHandler
methods.description: Removes the exception handler and restores previous exception ports.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Initializes the exception handler, creates message ports, and optionally installs handlers.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Cleans up and deallocates resources, removes handlers.

methods.name: SendMessageToHandlerThread
methods.description: Sends a message to the exception handler thread to trigger actions like dump writing.

methods.name: UpdateNextID
methods.description: Updates the filename and ID for the next minidump.

methods.name: SuspendThreads
methods.description: Suspends all threads except the current one.

methods.name: ResumeThreads
methods.description: Resumes all threads except the current one.
